tools.name: parkpow_list_vehicles
tools.description: List vehicles in the account with make, model, colour, type, payment status and tags. Plate match is case-insensitive and exact unless you use license_plate_contains. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/vehicles/.

tools.name: parkpow_list_visits
tools.description: List vehicle visits (camera sightings with plate, times and score), filterable by period, plate, site and vehicle details. Use start and end to keep the period small: pages past 100 fail, so use parkpow_list_visits_large for big exports. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/visit-list/.

tools.name: parkpow_list_visits_large
tools.description: List vehicle visits with cursor pagination, for large exports where parkpow_list_visits stops at page 100. Pass the cursor from the previous reply. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/visit-list-large/.

tools.name: parkpow_get_visit
tools.description: Get one visit by id: vehicle, start and end cameras, times, duration, score and plate images. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/visit/{id}/.

tools.name: parkpow_list_sites
tools.description: List parking lots (sites) with their cameras, number of parking spaces, current occupancy and occupancy percentage. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/parking-list/.

tools.name: parkpow_get_site_occupancy
tools.description: Get the live parking occupancy of one site: total spaces, free spaces and current occupancy. Read-only, though ParkPow takes it as a POST. ParkPow API: POST /api/v1/parking-occupancy/.

tools.name: parkpow_list_vehicle_tags
tools.description: List the vehicle tags defined in the account (ids and names). ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/vehicle-tags/.

tools.name: parkpow_list_vehicle_comments
tools.description: List comments on vehicles, optionally for one vehicle id. ParkPow API: GET /api/v1/vehicle-comments/.

tools.name: parkpow_create_vehicle
tools.description: Create a vehicle, or update the existing vehicle that ParkPow matches to this plate, with the fields you send. Use it to add tenant, employee or permit data (field1 to field6 are free-text custom fields). ParkPow API: POST /api/v1/create-vehicle/.

tools.name: parkpow_set_vehicle_tag
tools.description: Set a tag on a vehicle (checked = true) or clear it (checked = false). Repeating the same call gives the same result. Get ids from parkpow_list_vehicles and parkpow_list_vehicle_tags. ParkPow API: POST /api/v1/edit-tags/.

tools.name: parkpow_add_vehicle_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a vehicle. Each call adds a new comment, so repeating it adds a duplicate. ParkPow API: POST /api/v1/vehicle-comments/.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: parkpow_get_site_occupancy, parkpow_list_vehicle_comments, parkpow_set_vehicle_tag · Public sink: parkpow_get_site_occupancy, parkpow_create_vehicle, parkpow_set_vehicle_tag, parkpow_add_vehicle_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: parkpow_get_site_occupancy, parkpow_list_vehicle_comments, parkpow_set_vehicle_tag · Public sink: parkpow_get_site_occupancy, parkpow_create_vehicle, parkpow_set_vehicle_tag, parkpow_add_vehicle_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
